beats.composition_summary: Wide crayon-style airplane cabin interior. Two jagged broken passenger windows occupy the right side, with dense blue, green, and orange airflow streaks sweeping from the left cabin toward them. A striped scarf and loose cabin items are visibly airborne. Two passenger faces appear behind seatbacks on the left, and several oxygen masks hang from the overhead area.

targets.visible_evidence: A second passenger window near center-right has clearly jagged missing sections.

beats.notes: Primary attention is the large right-side broken opening and the dense streaks immediately feeding into it. Preserve the left passenger faces and airborne scarf as secondary evidence of the airflow; avoid a crop that removes the right window edge.
